recipe.method: tools/audio_beds.py build --recipe Art/audio-ambience/r001/recipe.json --downloads .local/ambience-downloads: per bed, an ffmpeg mix of the layers in recipe.json (trim, tape-style pitch, high/low-pass, fades, gain, pan, placements) to 48 kHz stereo float, rendered crossfade seconds past the loop length and folded over the head with an equal-power crossfade so the loop is seamless, then one gain to the ambience integrated loudness capped at -1 dBTP, then triangular dither to 16-bit PCM
recipe.approved_reference: Ticket #244 and spec #239: the Drowned Vigil (dripping stone nave, distant wind), the Root of the World (leaves, wind, insects and birds), the Vault (a low hum and the Waystone's resonance), the war table (candle crackle and room tone); dark high fantasy
recipe.raw_downloads: not committed: each source file used is listed with its SHA-256 in recipe.json, and build refuses a mismatch
